rmcss_two_views_rule: View A marginal/per-change operational cost (no double counting of already-built reusable indexes); View B preprocessing/setup cost (one-time builds). Report amortized examples at N=50 and N=300. Do not hide one-time preprocessing; do not charge the full one-time build to every task.
latency_provenance_rule: Stored SIP/RM-CSS latency from an earlier endpoint/machine is NOT directly same-machine comparable with fresh repository-agent latency. Latency stays descriptive unless re-measured under a matched environment WITHOUT changing predictions.
